name: Amstel Gold Race
story: A nine-man breakaway animated the early race, with Frigo the last survivor. On the Kruisberg with 42 km to go, Evenepoel, Skjelmose and Grégoire went clear after a crash eliminated Vauquelin and Jorgenson. Grégoire was dropped on the second ascent of the Cauberg, and Evenepoel sealed the win in the sprint-à-deux.
